sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: At the start of your next Turn, immediately after forming your Action Pool, burn 3 Action dice, or all remaining dice if fewer than 3 remain. Then remove Dazed. Reapplication does not add another penalty. Dazed has no immediate application cost and does not tax individual Actions or Reactions. It can empty a small Action Pool; otherwise-legal Movement remains available. A Mook or Normal profile states how it takes Dazed; by default it loses its Action allowance for the Turn.
